evals.prompt: Create a release-notes skill that works in Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Antigravity, OpenCode, and Qoder. It should turn merged changes into a Markdown release draft and include a README.
evals.expected_output: A portable skill with common SKILL.md metadata, a complete README, direct resource links, client compatibility notes, and validation evidence.
expectations: The skill directory contains SKILL.md and README.md
The SKILL.md name matches its directory and the description is at most 1024 characters
The output is checked against the current Agent Skills specification
Client-specific compatibility is documented without putting incompatible fields in portable frontmatter
The README contains at least three realistic example prompts

evals.prompt: Make this deployment skill explicit-only in Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and OpenCode. Deployments must never start from an automatic match.
evals.expected_output: A portable core plus client-specific invocation controls and a clear statement that no single frontmatter field enforces explicit-only behavior across all clients.
expectations: Claude Code and Cursor use disable-model-invocation in their targeted configuration
OpenCode access is handled in opencode.json or an equivalent documented permission configuration
SKILL.md retains the specification-required non-empty description
The solution does not claim that frontmatter is a cross-client security boundary

evals.prompt: Improve an existing skill whose description triggers on every request and whose 900-line SKILL.md contains long API tables, copied templates, and three repeated checklists.
evals.expected_output: A preserved skill identity, narrowed routing metadata, progressive disclosure, deduplicated instructions, and a before/after evaluation plan.
expectations: The existing skill name is preserved
The description is revised using trigger branches and near-miss boundaries
Conditional tables and templates move to directly linked support files
The evaluation compares the revised skill against the previous version

evals.prompt: Package a new standalone skill repository as a portable archive. Include everything consumers need but keep evaluation workspaces and maintainer-only scripts out of the artifact.
evals.expected_output: A source-first repository layout, explicit package allowlist, README and licensing guidance, clean-artifact validation, and a disciplined release sequence.
expectations: Runtime support files and required portable manifests or documented extensions are included in the package plan
Evaluation workspaces, caches, CI files, and maintainer-only material are excluded
The release sequence validates a clean packaged copy before publication
No installed cache is treated as the editable source
